## Sprint

* [Majorana and fermion-number-violating models are refused, not panicked on](sprint.md) - A process with a Majorana fermion or a fermion-number-violating vertex is refused before evaluation with an error naming the fermion flow, and the evaluator's panic sites are unreachable from such models.

## Sprint Record

* [Majorana and fermion-number-violating models are refused, not panicked on](closeout.md) - Diagram generation refuses a Majorana fermion (external or propagator) and a fermion-number-violating vertex with a named error; before, the FNV case panicked and Majorana processes silently returned a σ.
